newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end lower but off lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end lower but off lows.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures ended lower after a late bout of profit taking knocked prices back.
The Nasdaq Composite index also fell late to post its first loss in two weeks, rattling S&P 500 futures, traders said. The Nasdaq shed 12 points to end at 1569.
However, S&Ps recovered part of the decline after sliding to a fresh session low of 933.50 following the 1400 CDT close of Treasury bond futures.
"It calmly dropped and just as calmly rebounded. It was a pretty decisive move back up," said a stock index floor broker for a U.S. firm.
September bond futures also ended near their session lows after slipping late but finished just 1/32 lower at 114-21/32.

Firm Treasury bonds had underpinned S&Ps for much of the session, stock index traders said. September bond futures extended their months-long rally to another new high of 115-02, but volume was light and the trading range fairly narrow.
Stock index futures never recovered from an opening slide fueled by brisk dealer selling and lingering profit-taking from late Wednesday, traders said.
Profit-taking tugged on stocks after S&Ps rolled to another all-time high Wednesday along with the Dow Jones Industrial Average and Nasdaq.
September stock index futures proved unable to match the overnight high of 944.20 in daytime trading and remained below the record high of 946.75 established Wednesday.
Weakness in Intel Corp shares after this week's earnings-fueled runup set the early tone for S&Ps, floor traders said.
After the close, Microsoft Corp said its fiscal fourth quarter earnings were 80 cents per share, 1 cent above expectations and up from 43 cents a year earlier.

September S&Ps recovered from their opening loss and turned higher by midsession, aided by light short-covering, after bouncing off minor technical support near the session low of 937.00, technicians said.
Additional support for the contract was pegged at 931.75, with major support seen at 927.65.

S&P 500 futures ended down 4.35 points at 937.95, Nasdaq 100s fell 6.85 to 1107.50, Russell 2000s fell 0.85 point to 413.25, Nikkei 225 index futures fell 35.0 to 20,505.0 and Midcap 400s fell 2.05 points to 307.35.
